636-3(mi): des//dregs pa'i khrag zer 'phang ba ni//mon pa nag po'i thod pa la//
636-4(mi): dregs pa'i sil ma stong gi snying po bkod nas ni//de ru duga rdzas sna tshogs
636-5(mi): dang //ske tshe nyungs dkar nyungs na ga dang //zi ra dang ni ti la nag dang
636-6(mi): rgya bra zur gsum la sogs bshams//sha zan dgu'i snying /'dab chags
636-7(mi): dgu'i snying rmig zlum dgu'i snying rkang leb dgu'i snying rta dang
636-8(mi): dre'u dang /bong bu dang /btsos dang glang 'chi 'khris/de ltar bsag cing
636-9(mi): bsres la sbyar gyis bsing //de la drag po'i zor sngags bzlas//oM khre te sa
636-10(mi): la raM raM/traM b+h+yo/se me te 'u raM shing khA hi b+h+yo/ma ma tang le/sha khyer b+h+yo/
636-11(mi): ma ru thibs nA ga ya b+h+yo/yaHa la/sha sa zo ra ya/zhes bzlas shing dregs pa
636-12(mi): thams cad bskal zhing /las bcol la 'phang bar bya'o//de yis las rnams
636-13(mi): grub par byed//lta 'dre stong gi dra ba'i rgyad chen po las/dregs pa khrag zor
636-14(mi): de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar/dregs pa rnams kyis las kun
636-15(mi): la 'jug pa'i sngags 'di dril te sbas so//oM dza du ra yaM hi zad/dza du ra yaM
636-16(mi): hi rbad/srog la sbyar sri li shaM/khyer ya kha la dan se sam ti bad/gsha' ma
636-17(mi): dza du ra yaM/zhes sbas so//nya 'dre stong gi dra ba'i rgyud chen po las/dregs
